column2:
cake(n.)蛋糕
(無詞性變化)
birthday cake 生日蛋糕
a piece of cake 小事一樁、輕而易舉
Mom made a chocolate cake for me.
(媽媽為我做了一個巧克力蛋糕。)
This test is a piece of cake.
(這個考試簡直輕而易舉。)

call(v./n.)打電話、叫、稱呼
caller(n.)打電話的人、來訪者
call back 回電
phone call 電話
Please call me after school.
(放學後請打電話給我。)
We call our dog Lucky.
(我們叫我們的狗 Lucky。)

camera(n.)相機、攝影機
(無詞性變化)
digital camera 數位相機
security camera 監視器
I took this photo with my new camera.
(我用新相機拍了這張照片。)
Smile at the camera, please.
(請對著鏡頭微笑。)

camp(n./v.)營地、露營
camping(n.)露營活動
camper(n.)露營者
summer camp 夏令營
go camping 去露營
We went to summer camp last July.
(我們去年七月參加了夏令營。)
They camped by the lake.
(他們在湖邊露營。)

can(aux./n./v.)能夠、可以、罐頭、把…裝罐
could(aux.)能夠(過去式)、可以(委婉)
can of soda 一罐汽水
trash can 垃圾桶
I can swim very fast.
(我游泳游得很快。)
He drank a can of soda.
(他喝了一罐汽水。)

cap(n./v.)帽子(有帽舌)、蓋子、覆蓋
(無詞性變化)
baseball cap 棒球帽
bottle cap 瓶蓋
He always wears a red cap.
(他總是戴著一頂紅色帽子。)
Put the cap back on the pen.
(把筆蓋蓋回去。)

car(n.)汽車
(無詞性變化)
drive a car 開車
car accident 車禍
My dad drives a blue car.
(我爸爸開一輛藍色的車。)
We went to the beach by car.
(我們開車去海邊。)

card(n.)卡片、紙牌
(無詞性變化)
birthday card 生日卡
play cards 玩撲克牌
I sent her a birthday card.
(我寄給她一張生日卡片。)
Let's play cards after dinner.
(晚餐後我們來玩撲克牌吧。)

care(n./v.)照顧、關心、在乎
careful(adj.)小心的
careless(adj.)粗心的
take care of 照顧
care about 在乎、關心
She takes care of her little brother.
(她照顧她的弟弟。)
I don't care about the price.
(我不在乎價錢。)

careful(adj.)小心的、仔細的
carefully(adv.)小心地
care(n./v.)照顧、關心
be careful with 小心處理…
careful driver 謹慎的駕駛
Be careful when you cross the street.
(過馬路時要小心。)
She is a careful student.
(她是個細心的學生。)

carrot(n.)紅蘿蔔
(無詞性變化)
carrot juice 紅蘿蔔汁
carrot cake 紅蘿蔔蛋糕
Rabbits love to eat carrots.
(兔子很愛吃紅蘿蔔。)
I don't like carrots in my soup.
(我不喜歡湯裡有紅蘿蔔。)

carry(v.)攜帶、搬運
carrier(n.)搬運者、運輸工具
carry a bag 提袋子
carry out 執行、實行
Can you help me carry this box?
(你可以幫我搬這個箱子嗎？)
She always carries an umbrella.
(她總是隨身帶著雨傘。)

case(n./v.)情況、案件、盒子、把…裝箱
(無詞性變化)
in case 以防萬一
pencil case 鉛筆盒
Take an umbrella in case it rains.
(帶把傘以防下雨。)
My pencil case is on the desk.
(我的鉛筆盒在桌上。)

cat(n.)貓
kitten(n.)小貓
feed the cat 餵貓
pet cat 寵物貓
My cat sleeps on my bed.
(我的貓睡在我的床上。)
The cat is chasing a mouse.
(那隻貓正在追老鼠。)

catch(v./n.)抓住、接住、趕上、染上(疾病)
(無詞性變化)
catch a cold 感冒
catch the bus 趕上公車
He caught the ball with one hand.
(他用一隻手接住了球。)
Hurry, or we won't catch the bus.
(快點，不然我們會趕不上公車。)

celebrate(v.)慶祝
celebration(n.)慶祝、慶祝活動
celebrate a birthday 慶生
celebrate Christmas 慶祝聖誕節
We celebrated Grandma's birthday together.
(我們一起慶祝了奶奶的生日。)
How do you celebrate the New Year?
(你們怎麼慶祝新年？)

cellphone(n.)手機
(無詞性變化)
cellphone number 手機號碼
turn off your cellphone 把手機關機
Please turn off your cellphone in class.
(上課時請把手機關機。)
I left my cellphone at home.
(我把手機忘在家裡了。)

cent(n.)分(貨幣單位,一元的百分之一)
percent(n.)百分比
ten cents 十分錢
every cent 每一分錢
This candy costs fifty cents.
(這顆糖果要五十分錢。)
He saved every cent he earned.
(他把賺到的每一分錢都存起來。)

center(n.)中心、中央
central(adj.)中央的、主要的
shopping center 購物中心
in the center of 在…的中央
There is a big tree in the center of the park.
(公園中央有一棵大樹。)
Let's meet at the shopping center.
(我們在購物中心碰面吧。)

certain(adj./pron.)確定的、某些、某個
certainly(adv.)當然、無疑地
be certain of 確信…
a certain person 某個人
Are you certain about the time?
(你確定時間嗎？)
Certain students did not do their homework.
(某些學生沒寫作業。)

chair(n./v.)椅子、主持(會議)
chairman(n.)主席
sit on a chair 坐在椅子上
chair a meeting 主持會議
Please sit on this chair.
(請坐這張椅子。)
Our principal chaired the meeting.
(我們校長主持了這場會議。)

chance(n./v.)機會、可能性、碰巧
(無詞性變化)
have a chance to 有機會…
by chance 碰巧
I had a chance to visit Japan.
(我有機會去日本玩。)
We met by chance at the station.
(我們在車站碰巧遇見。)

change(n./v.)改變、零錢、換
changeable(adj.)易變的
change one's mind 改變主意
keep the change 不用找零
She changed her mind at the last minute.
(她在最後一刻改變了主意。)
Here is your change.
(這是找您的零錢。)

cheap(adj./adv.)便宜的、便宜地
cheaply(adv.)便宜地
cheap price 便宜的價格
buy something cheap 便宜買到東西
This shirt is very cheap.
(這件襯衫很便宜。)
Food here is cheap and good.
(這裡的食物又便宜又好吃。)

check(v./n.)檢查、核對、支票、帳單
(無詞性變化)
check in 辦理登記、報到
check the answer 核對答案
Please check your answers before you hand in.
(交卷前請檢查答案。)
Can I have the check, please?
(請給我帳單好嗎？)

cheese(n.)起司、乳酪
(無詞性變化)
a slice of cheese 一片起司
cheese sandwich 起司三明治
I want a sandwich with cheese.
(我想要一個夾起司的三明治。)
Say cheese for the photo!
(拍照時說「cheese」！)

chicken(n.)雞、雞肉、膽小鬼
(無詞性變化)
fried chicken 炸雞
chicken soup 雞湯
We had fried chicken for dinner.
(我們晚餐吃炸雞。)
Grandpa keeps ten chickens.
(爺爺養了十隻雞。)

child(n.)小孩、孩子
children(n.)小孩(複數)
childhood(n.)童年
only child 獨生子女
child care 托兒服務
She is an only child.
(她是獨生女。)
The children are playing in the park.
(孩子們正在公園玩。)

chocolate(n.)巧克力
(無詞性變化)
a bar of chocolate 一條巧克力
hot chocolate 熱可可
He gave me a box of chocolates.
(他送我一盒巧克力。)
I drink hot chocolate in winter.
(我冬天喝熱可可。)

choice(n./adj.)選擇、精選的
choose(v.)選擇
make a choice 做選擇
have no choice 別無選擇
You made the right choice.
(你做了正確的選擇。)
We had no choice but to wait.
(我們別無選擇，只能等待。)

choose(v.)選擇、挑選
choice(n.)選擇
choose between 在…之間選擇
choose to 決定、選擇做…
You can choose any color you like.
(你可以選任何你喜歡的顏色。)
She chose to stay at home.
(她選擇待在家裡。)

church(n.)教堂
(無詞性變化)
go to church 上教堂(做禮拜)
church bell 教堂鐘聲
They go to church every Sunday.
(他們每週日上教堂。)
There is an old church in the town.
(鎮上有一座古老的教堂。)

circle(n./v.)圓圈、圈子、圈出、環繞
circular(adj.)圓形的
draw a circle 畫圓
circle the answer 圈出答案
Please circle the right answer.
(請圈出正確答案。)
The kids sat in a circle.
(孩子們圍成一圈坐著。)

city(n.)城市
(無詞性變化)
big city 大城市
city hall 市政府
Taipei is a big city.
(台北是一座大城市。)
I like living in the city.
(我喜歡住在城市裡。)

class(n./v.)班級、課、等級、把…分類
classmate(n.)同班同學
classroom(n.)教室
in class 上課中
first class 頭等艙、一流的
We have English class today.
(我們今天有英文課。)
There are thirty students in my class.
(我們班上有三十個學生。)

clean(adj./v./adv./n.)乾淨的、清潔、完全地
cleaner(n.)清潔工、清潔劑
clean up 清理乾淨
keep clean 保持乾淨
Please clean your room.
(請打掃你的房間。)
The kitchen is very clean.
(廚房非常乾淨。)

clear(adj./v./adv.)清楚的、晴朗的、清除
clearly(adv.)清楚地
clear sky 晴朗的天空
make it clear 說清楚
The sky is clear today.
(今天天空很晴朗。)
Please clear the table after dinner.
(晚餐後請收拾桌子。)

clerk(n.)店員、職員
(無詞性變化)
bank clerk 銀行行員
office clerk 辦公室職員
The clerk helped me find a jacket.
(店員幫我找到一件外套。)
My aunt works as a bank clerk.
(我阿姨是銀行行員。)

climb(v./n.)爬、攀登、攀爬
climber(n.)登山者、攀登者
climb a mountain 爬山
climb a tree 爬樹
We climbed Yangmingshan last weekend.
(我們上週末去爬陽明山。)
The boy climbed up the tree.
(那個男孩爬到樹上。)

clock(n.)時鐘
(無詞性變化)
alarm clock 鬧鐘
around the clock 日以繼夜地
My alarm clock rings at six.
(我的鬧鐘六點響。)
The clock on the wall is slow.
(牆上的時鐘慢了。)

close(adj./adv./v./n.)接近的、親密的、關閉、結束
closely(adv.)密切地、仔細地
closed(adj.)關著的、停止營業的
close friend 密友
close the door 關門
Please close the window.
(請把窗戶關上。)
She is my close friend.
(她是我的好朋友。)

clothes(n.)衣服
cloth(n.)布料
clothing(n.)衣物(總稱)
change clothes 換衣服
wash clothes 洗衣服
I need to buy some new clothes.
(我需要買一些新衣服。)
He changed his clothes after the game.
(比賽後他換了衣服。)

cloud(n.)雲
cloudy(adj.)多雲的
dark cloud 烏雲
white cloud 白雲
There are dark clouds in the sky.
(天空中有烏雲。)
The cloud looks like a rabbit.
(那朵雲看起來像一隻兔子。)

club(n./v.)社團、俱樂部、棍棒、用棍棒打
(無詞性變化)
join a club 加入社團
club activity 社團活動
I joined the music club.
(我加入了音樂社。)
Our club meets every Friday.
(我們社團每週五聚會。)

coat(n./v.)外套、大衣、塗上一層
(無詞性變化)
put on a coat 穿上外套
winter coat 冬季大衣
Put on your coat. It's cold.
(穿上外套，天氣很冷。)
She bought a new winter coat.
(她買了一件新的冬季大衣。)

coffee(n.)咖啡
(無詞性變化)
a cup of coffee 一杯咖啡
coffee shop 咖啡店
My father drinks coffee every morning.
(我爸爸每天早上喝咖啡。)
Let's meet at the coffee shop.
(我們在咖啡店見吧。)

cold(adj./n.)冷的、冷淡的、感冒、寒冷
coldly(adv.)冷淡地
catch a cold 感冒
cold water 冷水
It is very cold today.
(今天非常冷。)
I caught a cold last week.
(我上週感冒了。)

collect(v.)收集、收取
collection(n.)收藏品、收集
collector(n.)收藏家
collect stamps 集郵
collect money 募款、收錢
My brother likes to collect stamps.
(我哥哥喜歡集郵。)
The teacher collected our homework.
(老師收了我們的作業。)

color(n./v.)顏色、著色
colorful(adj.)色彩豐富的
favorite color 最喜歡的顏色
bright color 鮮豔的顏色
What is your favorite color?
(你最喜歡什麼顏色？)
The children colored the pictures.
(孩子們幫圖畫著色。)

come(v.)來、到來
(無詞性變化)
come back 回來
come true 實現
Please come to my party.
(請來參加我的派對。)
I hope your dream will come true.
(希望你的夢想會實現。)

comfortable(adj.)舒服的、舒適的
comfort(n./v.)舒適、安慰
comfortably(adv.)舒服地
feel comfortable 感到舒服
comfortable shoes 舒適的鞋子
This sofa is very comfortable.
(這張沙發非常舒服。)
Wear comfortable shoes for the trip.
(旅行時要穿舒適的鞋子。)

common(adj./n.)常見的、共同的、公有地
commonly(adv.)普遍地
common sense 常識
in common 共同的
Chen is a common last name in Taiwan.
(陳是台灣常見的姓氏。)
We have a lot in common.
(我們有很多共同點。)

computer(n.)電腦
(無詞性變化)
computer game 電腦遊戲
use a computer 使用電腦
I do my homework on the computer.
(我用電腦寫作業。)
Our school has a new computer room.
(我們學校有一間新的電腦教室。)

convenient(adj.)方便的、便利的
convenience(n.)方便、便利
conveniently(adv.)方便地
convenience store 便利商店
convenient for 對…方便
The MRT is very convenient.
(捷運非常方便。)
Is Monday convenient for you?
(星期一你方便嗎？)

cook(v./n.)煮、烹飪、廚師
cooker(n.)炊具
cooking(n.)烹飪
cook dinner 煮晚餐
a good cook 好廚師
My mom cooks dinner every day.
(我媽媽每天煮晚餐。)
He is a very good cook.
(他廚藝很好。)

cookie(n.)餅乾
(無詞性變化)
bake cookies 烤餅乾
chocolate chip cookie 巧克力豆餅乾
We baked cookies for the party.
(我們為派對烤了餅乾。)
Can I have another cookie?
(我可以再吃一片餅乾嗎？)

cool(adj./v./n.)涼爽的、酷的、冷靜的、使變涼
cooler(n.)冷藏箱
cool down 冷卻、冷靜下來
stay cool 保持冷靜
It is cool in the evening.
(傍晚很涼爽。)
Your new bike looks cool!
(你的新腳踏車看起來好酷！)

copy(n./v.)副本、一份(書報)、複製、抄襲
copier(n.)影印機
make a copy 影印一份
copy homework 抄作業
Please make ten copies of this page.
(請把這一頁影印十份。)
Don't copy your friend's homework.
(不要抄朋友的作業。)

corner(n.)角落、轉角
(無詞性變化)
around the corner 在附近、即將來臨
street corner 街角
The bank is on the corner.
(銀行在轉角處。)
Christmas is just around the corner.
(聖誕節快到了。)

correct(adj./v.)正確的、改正、批改
correction(n.)改正、訂正
correctly(adv.)正確地
correct answer 正確答案
correct mistakes 改正錯誤
Your answer is correct.
(你的答案是正確的。)
The teacher corrected my mistakes.
(老師改正了我的錯誤。)

cost(n./v.)費用、成本、花費
costly(adj.)昂貴的
cost of living 生活費
at all costs 不惜任何代價
How much does this bag cost?
(這個包包多少錢？)
The trip cost me a lot of money.
(這趟旅行花了我很多錢。)

couch(n./v.)長沙發、措辭表達
(無詞性變化)
couch potato 整天窩在沙發看電視的人
sit on the couch 坐在沙發上
Dad is sleeping on the couch.
(爸爸正睡在沙發上。)
Don't be a couch potato.
(別整天窩在沙發上看電視。)

count(v./n.)數、計算、重要、計數
countless(adj.)數不清的
count to ten 數到十
count on 依靠、指望
Can you count to ten in English?
(你能用英文數到十嗎？)
You can count on me.
(你可以依靠我。)

country(n.)國家、鄉下
countryside(n.)鄉間
foreign country 外國
in the country 在鄉下
Japan is a beautiful country.
(日本是個美麗的國家。)
My grandparents live in the country.
(我的祖父母住在鄉下。)

course(n./v.)課程、路線、一道菜、(液體)流動
(無詞性變化)
of course 當然
take a course 修課
Of course you can come with us.
(你當然可以跟我們一起來。)
She is taking a cooking course.
(她正在上烹飪課。)

cousin(n.)堂/表兄弟姊妹
(無詞性變化)
first cousin 嫡親堂/表兄弟姊妹
visit a cousin 拜訪堂/表親
My cousin lives in Tainan.
(我的表哥住在台南。)
I played games with my cousins.
(我和堂兄弟姊妹們一起玩遊戲。)

cover(v./n.)覆蓋、涵蓋、報導、封面、蓋子
covering(n.)覆蓋物
cover with 用…覆蓋
book cover 書的封面
Snow covered the mountain.
(雪覆蓋了那座山。)
I like the cover of this book.
(我喜歡這本書的封面。)

cow(n.)母牛、乳牛
(無詞性變化)
milk a cow 擠牛奶
dairy cow 乳牛
The cow is eating grass.
(那頭牛正在吃草。)
We get milk from cows.
(我們從乳牛身上取得牛奶。)

crazy(adj.)瘋狂的、著迷的
crazily(adv.)瘋狂地
be crazy about 對…著迷
go crazy 發瘋、抓狂
He is crazy about basketball.
(他對籃球很著迷。)
The noise is driving me crazy.
(這噪音快把我逼瘋了。)

cross(n./v.)十字形、叉號、穿越、交叉
crossing(n.)十字路口、穿越處
cross the street 過馬路
cross one's arms 交叉雙臂
Look both ways before you cross the street.
(過馬路前要看兩邊。)
Put a cross next to the wrong answers.
(在錯誤的答案旁打叉。)

cry(v./n.)哭、大叫、哭聲、叫聲
(無詞性變化)
cry for help 呼救
start to cry 開始哭
The baby cried all night.
(那個嬰兒哭了一整晚。)
We heard a cry for help.
(我們聽到一聲呼救。)

cup(n.)杯子
(無詞性變化)
a cup of tea 一杯茶
World Cup 世界盃
Would you like a cup of tea?
(你要來杯茶嗎？)
I broke my favorite cup.
